title: Surreal Teardrop Car Scene
description: A woman with a ponytail in a black top and pink pants sits on a colorful patchwork car with blue wheels. She leans against a large blue teardrop-shaped structure containing a vibrant spiral, with another smaller teardrop car to the right and a sketch of three teardrop designs on the floor.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a woman with a dark ponytail wearing a black top and bright pink pants, sitting on a colorful patchwork car with blue wheels and orange hubs. She leans against a large blue teardrop structure filled with a vibrant swirling spiral of pink, green, and purple. A smaller matching teardrop car sits to the right. On the floor is a white paper with sketches of three teardrop designs. The background is a warm orange-brown gradient with paint splatters, in a vibrant surreal painting style.
